legal.draftNote: Draft. A lawyer should review this text before public launch.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Avtoskop (avtoskop.com.ua) is an online service where buyers describe the car they want and sellers send them offers. The service is provided by {operator}. Contact: {email}.

sections.title: 2. Our role
sections.body: We only connect buyers and sellers. We don't sell cars, aren't a party to any deal, don't take payment for cars, and don't guarantee a car's condition, price or a seller's honesty. All agreements and payments are between buyer and seller.

sections.title: 3. For buyers
sections.body: Enter only your own phone number. A request is published after you confirm the number in Telegram. You decide which sellers get your number; this can't be undone. Don't pay a deposit before you have seen the car and documents and signed a contract.

sections.title: 4. For sellers
sections.body: An offer must be about a real car you can sell or deliver. The price must be all-in, including delivery, customs and registration. You may not demand a deposit without a contract, send the same offer to every request, use buyers' numbers for anything other than this deal, or pass them to others.

sections.title: 5. Not allowed for anyone
sections.body: Fraud, false requests or offers, other people's phone numbers, spam, abuse, cars of illegal origin, or cars registered in russia or belarus.

sections.title: 6. Moderation
sections.body: We may review sellers, limit the number of offers, hide offers and block accounts that break these terms, including after buyer complaints. The "Verified seller" badge only means we reviewed the seller's profile and contacts; it doesn't guarantee a deal.

sections.title: 7. Liability
sections.body: The service is provided as is. We aren't liable for losses from deals between buyers and sellers, but we act on complaints and block offenders.

sections.title: 8. Changes
sections.body: We may change these terms; a new version applies from the update date on this page.

sections.title: 1. Who processes data
sections.body: Data is processed by {operator} under the Law of Ukraine "On Personal Data Protection". Contact about data: {email}.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
sections.body: Buyers: phone number, request details (car, budget, region, wishes, comment), site language, and Telegram ID after the number is confirmed. Sellers: Telegram ID, Telegram name and username, profile details (name, type, region, countries, description) and offers. The site uses only technical cookies for sign-in; there are no advertising cookies.

sections.title: 3. How we protect numbers
sections.body: A buyer's number is stored only encrypted and shown only to sellers the buyer chose. We don't store sellers' numbers, only a protected fingerprint to prevent duplicate accounts.

sections.title: 4. Why
sections.body: To publish requests without contact details, deliver offers, notify you in Telegram about new offers, prevent fraud and duplicates, and handle complaints.

sections.title: 5. Who we share with
sections.body: A buyer's number goes only to sellers the buyer chose. Notifications are sent through Telegram. Data is stored on servers in the EU. We don't sell data or share it with advertisers.

sections.title: 6. How long
sections.body: While a request or account is active, and 12 months after a request is closed, to handle complaints. Then we delete or anonymise the data.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You can ask what data we hold, correct it, withdraw consent or ask us to delete it: write to {email}. We reply within 30 days.
